title: Decode an Ambisonic sound field natively, then render its spatial meaning separately

definition.title: Decode an Ambisonic sound field natively, then render its spatial meaning separately
definition.source_excerpt: Decode a restricted Opus Ambisonic component set through qualified browser decoders and apply the specified ordering, normalization and spatial renderer. Distinguish decoded components, rendered stereo and actual spatial hardware.
